Customer Profile: Extremely frequent buyers with massive lifetime spend and very recent activity.
Recommended Action: Provide VIP treatment (early product access, dedicated support) and absolutely no margin-eating discounts.
Experiment: Holdout Test: Suppress a 10% control group from all promotional discounts for 6 months to prove discounting this segment wastes margin.
Risk: Margin erosion from over-discounting customers who would buy at full price regardless.

Customer Profile: Proven historical high-spenders whose engagement has severely decayed (slipping Recency).
Recommended Action: Deploy aggressive discounts or assign a dedicated account manager for personalized phone outreach to trigger a single transaction.
Experiment: A/B Test: Automated 30% discount vs. personalized account manager outreach to see if human touch lifts reactivation.
Risk: Permanent churn resulting in the loss of £545k in established recurring revenue.

Customer Profile: Consistent, steady repeat buyers with solid but average lifetime spend.
Recommended Action: Introduce product bundles, volume pricing tiers, and cross-category recommendations to increase basket size.
Experiment: A/B Test: Standard single-item promotion vs. a bundled 'Buy 2 Get 1 Free' volume offer.
Risk: Leaving money on the table; failing to push them over the threshold into the highly lucrative Champion tier.

Customer Profile: Recent acquisitions who have only made 1 or 2 purchases historically.
Recommended Action: Implement an automated onboarding series and trigger a specific incentive tied explicitly to completing a second purchase.
Experiment: A/B Test: Timing of second-purchase incentive (trigger on Day 15 vs Day 30 post-acquisition) to find optimal habit formation window.
Risk: High early-churn risk; if they do not form a buying habit quickly, they will plummet into the Lost segment.

Customer Profile: Total inactivity for 6+ months, coupled with historically low spend and frequency.
Recommended Action: Remove these customers from all paid retargeting/direct mail lists. Retain them only on passive, zero-marginal-cost channels.
Experiment: Holdout Test: Suppress 50% from all paid marketing to mathematically prove ad spend generates zero incremental organic reactivation.
Risk: Wasting active marketing budget on dead accounts, generating deeply negative Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
